steps.instructionEn:
Deliver stack-trace.csv and verification failures; the simplified ISA does not parse full.class files. Executable offline evidence: python3 tools/curriculum-v29/labs-systems.py --lab soft-v29-036 --out ./soft-v29-036-evidence; the output directory must not already exist.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Interface and data contract: JVM: stack bytecode and verification: Investigation 1 acceptance: After five instructions only20 remains and max_stack is2; removing the second push must reject underflow before add. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Trace PC, operation and before/after stacks; add and mul each consume two integers and push one. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
